questions.hint: Same product, same market, more effort means penetration.

options.misconception: assumes entry into a new geographic market
mistakes a deeper push in current markets for a completely new venture
confuses selling more of the same product with creating new products

questions.subject: MARKETING
questions.stem: Calder Toys, a privately held firm spent $36,668 on a Ironvale campaign that generated $42,822 in attributable revenue. What was the return on ad spend, rounded to two decimals?
questions.explanation: Return on ad spend is attributable revenue divided by advertising spend. Here $42,822 divided by $36,668 is about 1.17x. Return on investment would instead use the profit, revenue minus spend, as the numerator and give 0.17 as a ratio, which is a different measure. Inverting the ratio would report spend per dollar of revenue.
questions.hint: Divide revenue by ad spend.

options.misconception: inverts revenue and spend
computes return on investment instead of return on ad spend
shifts the decimal by using a wrong divisor
